messages:
Priya (CS): FYI from today's ClearVista onboarding: finance and platform teams raised the same three asks across calls — per-route chargeback numbers, ability to lock an embedding model per route, and a one-page rollout checklist with sample prompts. They said without per-route numbers they can't do internal billing and may pause further seats.

Marco (PM): Thanks Priya. Can you paste the exact quotes and which routes they care about?

Priya (CS): Verbatim snippets: 
- "We need chargeback numbers by endpoint so product teams are billed properly."
- "If embedding spend spikes, we need to pin a cheaper model to our search route."
- "A one-pager checklist with starter prompts would have saved us setup time."
Mentioned routes `billing-alloc` and `search-embeds` in 4 calls.

June (Product): Good catch. Triage proposal: 1) checklist + prompts = immediate ship (low effort), 2) CSV export of per-route billing as stopgap, 3) embed-pin per-route API, 4) full console per-route UI on roadmap.

Ethan (Eng): For CSV stopgap we can expose a simple authenticated endpoint that returns per-route totals. Rough estimate: 2 dev days (agg + endpoint + auth). Embedding-pin needs a small metadata table + override check in runtime, ~3 dev days. UI/dashboard is multi-sprint. Example ad-hoc query for CS to use: 
SELECT route_id, DATE(ts) day, SUM(cost_cents) total_cents FROM billing_events WHERE account_id='clearvista' GROUP BY route_id, day;

Priya (CS): I'll open a cs:feedback ticket and attach call snippets. Recommend marking ClearVista as at-risk if no CSV within 7 business days. Also requesting a one-pager enablement slide for CSMs.

Marco (PM): Action items: Priya opens ticket; Product drafts checklist; Eng scopes CSV and embed-pin and posts estimates. I'll mark CSV as P0 quick-win for retention.

NotifyBot: JIRA ticket CS-5347 created by Priya (CS) - "ClearVista onboarding: per-route chargeback CSV + embed-pin + checklist" - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-5347

Ethan (Eng): Adding CS-5347 to sprint prep; will post sample CSV and PR link here when ready.

June (Product): Drafting checklist now, will share for CS signoff by EOD.

Priya (CS): Thanks team — I'll update ClearVista with interim expectations and track renewal risk.
